passwordSetup.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.
passwordSetup.title: Set Up Your Database
passwordSetup.description: Your database is encrypted on this device, and this password is required to open it every time you return. Choose a strong password — there is no password recovery, so store it somewhere safe.
passwordSetup.recoveryDescription: Your database is encrypted on this device. A 12-word recovery phrase, generated for you, will be the only way to open it — there is no other way to recover your data, so keep it somewhere safe.
passwordSetup.recoveryHint: Instead of a password you memorise, you will get 12 random words to write down. Anyone with the words can open the database, and without them nobody can — including you.

passwordEntry.title: Enter Password
passwordEntry.defaultDescription: This database is encrypted. Enter the password to open it.

recoverySetup.title: Your Recovery Phrase
recoverySetup.description: These 12 words are the only way to open your database. Write them down in order and keep them somewhere safe — they are never stored anywhere, and there is no other way to recover your data.
recoverySetup.savedCheckbox: I have written down these 12 words
recoverySetup.confirmDescription: Enter the requested words to confirm you wrote the phrase down correctly.
recoverySetup.confirmMismatch: One or more words do not match. Check your written phrase and try again.

recoveryEntry.defaultDescription: This database is protected by a recovery phrase. Enter its 12 words to open it.
recoveryEntry.label: Recovery phrase
recoveryEntry.placeholder: Enter the 12 words separated by spaces
recoveryEntry.badChecksum: The phrase doesn't check out — one or more words are wrong.

legacy.title: This database needs to be set up again
legacy.description: The database on this device was created by an older version of the app, which encrypted it in a way this version can no longer open. Reset the app to start fresh or to restore a backup exported from a current version.
legacy.confirmBody: This permanently deletes the database stored in this browser along with the app's settings. Backups you exported or synced to the cloud are not affected, but only backups from a current version can be restored.
